international.title: Caribbean nations fear economic impact of shuttering citizenship program after EU threats
international.summary: St Kitts and Nevis to wind down citizenship-by-investment program after EU warns of end to visa-free access The decision by St Kitts and Nevis to end a lucrative programme offering citizenship to wealthy foreigners in exchange for investment threatens its economy and ability to support people in need, the premier of the island of Nevis has warned. On Friday, Terrance Drew, the prime minister of the twin-island Caribbean nation, announced he would wind down the citizenship-by-investment (CBI) programme, after the European Union threatened to end visa-free access for St Kitts and Nevis.
